fields.Name: whova
fields.Description: Whova events / conference-management connector. Read-only over Attendees, Orders and Registrants, each scoped by a required per-tenant Event. Whova publishes no machine-readable API contract; base URL, auth scheme and object paths resolve at runtime.

Configuration.universalPKNote: No vendor-documented primary-key convention found anywhere in the credential-free surface (no OpenAPI x-primary-key, no prose statement of an 'id' field). Per-object PK determination is deferred to per-IO extraction evidence or runtime D4 SoftPKClassifier — do not assume a vendor-wide 'id' convention without a doc marker.
Configuration.AuthFlowNote: UNDOCUMENTED. Whova has no direct/native REST API for third-party self-integration; CRM/system integration is routed exclusively through Whova's own Zapier app (Zendesk article 28473285536795 title: 'How do I integrate CRM via Zapier?'). Zapier abstracts the underlying auth scheme behind its own connected-account OAuth/API-key flow, so the actual credential shape Whova's backend expects (API key vs OAuth2 vs partner token) is invisible from any credential-free source. Escalated as a gap in SOURCE_STUDY.md §5 (last row) rather than guessed. A wrong guess here (e.g. assuming 'api-key') would violate the provable-only / no-InferredFromContext-for-hard-constraints rule.
Configuration.PaginationDefaultsNote: UNDOCUMENTED. Zapier's public trigger/action listing shows input field lists only, not response payload shapes, pagination cursors, or page-size parameters. No OpenAPI spec exists to declare a pagination scheme (SOURCE_STUDY.md §0 — SchemaContractStatus=NoMachineReadableContractFound). Per-IO PaginationType is set to the safe enum default None pending discovery; do not assume Cursor/Offset/PageNumber without evidence.

IncrementalSyncCapability.note: UNDOCUMENTED at the integration level. Zapier's trigger descriptions ('Triggers when there is a change in the attendee list' / 'order list' / 'registration form responses') imply Zapier itself polls for deltas, but no incremental query parameter (e.g. an updated-since filter or watermark field) is documented in the public trigger listing. Do not set SupportsIncrementalSync=true on any IO without an explicit watermark field per connector-provenance-conventions.md hard-constraint rule.

Configuration.WebhooksNote: No webhook subscription/management endpoint documented anywhere in the credential-free surface (Zapier's own triggers are Zapier-side polling constructs, not a Whova-exposed webhook API). Recorded false as the honest default — not confirmed absent, just never evidenced present.
Configuration.BulkNote: No batch/bulk endpoint documented. The only write surface found is the single-record 'Create or Update Attendee' Zapier action.
Configuration.APIVersioningNote: UNDOCUMENTED — no API path, spec, or version header was ever observed (no machine-readable contract exists per SOURCE_STUDY.md §0).
Configuration.ErrorResponseShapeNote: UNDOCUMENTED. No error response body shape, status code catalog, or rate-limit error code was found in any credential-free source.

CustomFieldMarkerPattern.note: Whova exposes a large vendor-provided MENU of organizer-configurable optional attendee-profile custom fields (pronouns, role, credentials, chapter, department, major, program, school, affiliation, industry, expertise, education level, certifications, awards, graduating class, portfolio, project examples, skills, teaching level, mentor/investor flags, interests, hobbies, networking goals — source: https://whova.com/blog/attendee-profile-custom-fields/). This is a per-event opt-in field catalog, not a fixed schema, and no naming-prefix convention (comparable to HubSpot's p_<accountID>_<name>) is documented for distinguishing custom vs. system fields at the API level. Field-mapping/customs-capture logic should treat any attendee field outside the Zapier action's documented required/optional list (Event, First Name, Last Name, Email, Title, Affiliation/Company, Location, Ticket Types, Audience Type, Categories) as potentially custom.
CustomFieldMarkerPattern.eventScoping: Every discovered trigger/action is scoped by a required 'Event' parameter — Whova is a multi-tenant-per-organizer, single-tenant-per-event platform. The connector's object model should treat Event as a required per-sync-scope parameter (configured via CompanyIntegration.Configuration), not as a syncable Events IO itself. Source: https://zapier.com/apps/whova/integrations.

WriteCapability.scope: Attendees only (Create or Update Attendee action)
WriteCapability.create: Yes — Attendees, via the 'Create or Update Attendee' Zapier action (also functions as upsert — same action creates or updates by matching Email within the Event).
WriteCapability.update: Yes — same action, upsert semantics (no separate distinct create vs. update endpoint documented).
WriteCapability.delete: UNDOCUMENTED — no delete action found for Attendees or any other object in the credential-free surface.
WriteCapability.otherObjects: Orders and Registrants are READ-ONLY (Zapier triggers only — 'Get Orders', 'Get Registrants' — no corresponding write action exists for either in the discovered surface). A pull-only default for Orders/Registrants and pull+limited-push for Attendees is the evidence-supported capability shape; treating the whole vendor as uniformly read-only OR uniformly bidirectional would both be capability-dishonest per connector-code-conventions.md.

Configuration.ConcurrencyControlNote: No ETag, If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, or version field is documented anywhere in the credential-free surface (there is no API reference at all beyond the Zapier action's flat input-field list). Conflict resolution must use snapshot-3-way only — do not recommend MostRecent.
Configuration.DeleteSemanticsNote: No delete operation of any kind is documented for any Whova object in the credential-free surface. DeleteBehavior for any future bidirectional EntityMap cannot be set until a delete surface is discovered (live credential or vendor contact).
Configuration.DefaultSyncDirectionNote: Read-only default for every object per connector-code-conventions.md safety discipline, regardless of the documented Attendees write action. Bidirectional (even for Attendees, the only object with any documented write capability) requires sandbox validation first — see BidirectionalPreconditions below.
Configuration.DefaultConflictResolutionReason: ConcurrencyControl=none (no ETag/version field documented anywhere) rules out MostRecent as a safe default. DestWins is the conservative default if/when Attendees is ever enabled for bidirectional sync — it overwrites the MJ destination with Whova's source-of-truth on pull, avoiding silent conflict-loss in either direction until a real concurrency signal is discovered.
BidirectionalPreconditions: Obtain a live/sandbox Whova credential and empirically confirm the actual request/response shape of the 'Create or Update Attendee' write path (field types, upsert-match key behavior, error codes) — currently known only from Zapier's flat input-field list, never from a real API reference.
Confirm whether Whova exposes ANY delete/archive operation for Attendees before allowing DeleteBehavior other than 'never delete via sync'.

Confirm whether a concurrency signal (ETag/version/last-modified-on-write) exists on the live API — current evidence (none discovered) implies conflict resolution can only be snapshot-3-way, which is a materially weaker safety net than MostRecent.
Confirm the true auth scheme (currently UNDOCUMENTED — Zapier abstracts it) so credential rotation/expiry and write-retry semantics can be implemented correctly.

Validate write behavior against a sandbox/test event before any bidirectional EntityMap touches a client's real event data — per the read-first, bidirectional-opt-in discipline, this must never be turned on by default.

Configuration.DescriptionFull: Whova events / conference management platform connector. No vendor-published machine-readable API contract (OpenAPI/Postman/SDK) exists as of 2026-07-02; the only credential-free-provable programmatic surface is Whova's own Zapier app (3 triggers: Get Attendees, Get Orders, Get Registrants; 1 write action: Create or Update Attendee), all scoped by a required Event parameter. Base URL, auth scheme, and rate limits for Whova's underlying private API are not documented publicly and are recorded as gaps pending a live credential or vendor partnership contact.

Configuration.eventScopeNote: Every Whova trigger/action requires an 'Event' scoping parameter. Event is a per-sync-scope input (configured via CompanyIntegration.Configuration), NOT a synced column or FK on this record.

zapierSurface.action: Create or Update Attendee (upsert by Email within Event)

Configuration.WriteCapabilityNote: SupportsWrite downgraded to false in amendment round 1 for bijection consistency: a documented 'Create or Update Attendee' write action exists at the Zapier level (see Integration.Configuration.WriteCapability), but NO REST path/method/body-shape is documented for Whova's private backend, so CreateAPIPath/CreateMethod cannot be honestly populated credential-free. The write capability is real but unverifiable structurally; it is re-enabled at runtime once a credentialed path is discovered. Downgrading (rather than fabricating a path) keeps the per-IO capability<->column contract consistent.
Configuration.APIPathNote: APIPath is intentionally EMPTY and Status is Disabled: Whova publishes no machine-readable API contract and no native third-party REST API, so no request path for this object is provable credential-free (SchemaContractStatus=NoMachineReadableContractFound). An empty path asserts nothing — it is the absence of a value, not a claim. __mj.IntegrationObject.APIPath is NOT NULL, so null cannot be seeded. Populate APIPath and flip Status to Active only once a credentialed REST path is actually observed; until then the object is declared but never synced.

fields.Name: FirstName
fields.Description: Attendee's first name (required on the Create or Update Attendee action).

fields.Name: LastName
fields.Description: Attendee's last name (required on the Create or Update Attendee action).

fields.Name: Email
fields.Description: Attendee's email address. Serves as the upsert-match key for the Create or Update Attendee action (Whova matches on Email within the Event). Documented required + unique-within-event.

fields.Name: TicketTypes
fields.Description: Ticket type(s) assigned to the attendee (optional). Appears as an enum-like value on the action; the underlying tickets catalog is not a separately-syncable object in the credential-free surface.

fields.Name: AudienceType
fields.Description: Attendance mode: 'in_person' or 'remote' (optional, documented value set). Documented value set: in_person,remote.

fields.Name: Categories
fields.Description: Attendee category / categories used for segmentation and export filtering (optional).
